comparator.name: International Bachelor History
comparator.route: Social History focus area with minor/internship option
comparator.sourceNotes: The current official programme is a three-year, 180-EC history bachelor. Year 1 is common; from year 2 students choose Economic History, International Relations, Social History or Cultural History. The neutral Social History focus area is used because it retains the broadest historical-social identity without choosing a UCR-favourable specialist route. The third year includes profile space and culminates in public-history work, a thesis class and a bachelor thesis.

alternativeSelection.assessment: The broad closest match captures historical development, source criticism, social history, culture and public communication. Economic History and International Relations each provide a coherent, feasible and substantially distinct additional direction. Cultural History is already represented inside the closest-match curriculum. History education is not included as a separate pathway because UCR does not provide the pedagogy, supervised school practice or teaching qualification needed for a defensible education route. Three alternatives are included, the maximum.
